input.final_result:
Answer: Amazon (AMZN) plans to spend the most capex in 2025, about $100 billion. As of April 7, 2025: Alphabet (GOOG) guided to ~$75B and Meta (META) to $60–65B.

- Amazon: ~$100B guided on its Q4 2024 call (Feb 2025), up from $83B in 2024. The figure also includes e-commerce warehouses and offices. It is an annualized run-rate estimate from Q4 capex of $26.3B.
- Alphabet: ~$75B, per its Q4 2024 earnings release (Feb 4, 2025). That is about $25B less than Amazon.
- Meta: $60–65B, per its January 2025 guidance (midpoint $62.5B). That is about $37.5B less than Amazon at the midpoint.

Amazon's figure is the highest even at the low end of the other two ranges. Post-April 7, 2025 revisions were excluded.
